title: Decide whether the evidence earns an answer
description: Pack a finite context, enforce freshness and citation policies, isolate untrusted retrieval, and choose a containment action. The gate separates answer quality from permission to serve.

citationPolicies.label: No citations
citationPolicies.detail: The answer exposes no claim-to-source path.

citationPolicies.label: Source list
citationPolicies.detail: Sources are present, but readers cannot tell which claim each supports.

citationPolicies.label: Claim-linked citations
citationPolicies.detail: Every factual claim must identify its supporting chunk.

evidencePolicies.label: Pass through
evidencePolicies.detail: Retrieved text enters the prompt without isolation or quarantine.

evidencePolicies.label: Delimit only
evidencePolicies.detail: Evidence is labeled as data, but suspicious chunks still reach the model.

evidencePolicies.label: Scan, quarantine, delimit
evidencePolicies.detail: Suspicious chunks are removed and remaining evidence stays untrusted data.

fallbacks.label: Best-effort answer
fallbacks.detail: Request an answer even when an evidence gate fails.

fallbacks.label: Explain and abstain
fallbacks.detail: Return no factual answer and name the missing evidence.

fallbacks.label: Route to review
fallbacks.detail: Contain the request in a bounded human or specialist queue.

scenarios.label: Current, aligned evidence
scenarios.detail: Authorized sources agree and jointly support five answer claims.
scenarios.query: What is the enterprise refund path?

scenarios.label: Stale release note
scenarios.detail: Current material covers the basics, but a retired note is the only source for two claims.
scenarios.query: Which limits changed in yesterday's release?

scenarios.label: Retrieved prompt injection
scenarios.detail: A highly ranked imported note contains both useful text and hostile instructions.

scenarios.label: Conflicting policy revisions
scenarios.detail: A current policy and an older high-scoring copy disagree on the approval limit.
scenarios.query: Who can approve a refund above 5,000 dollars?
